# Vendored browser dependency

DOMPurify **3.4.15**, `dist/purify.min.js`, copied from the published npm package on September 10, 2026.

- Upstream: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dompurify/v/3.4.15
- License: see `DOMPurify-LICENSE` (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0)

The sanitizer is part of the precached application shell so medication search, history, and other dynamic controls remain usable offline. When updating it, preserve the license and advance the service-worker release and resource version together.
